arguments.name: forward_to
arguments.description: List of receivers to send log entries to.

arguments.name: relabel_rules
arguments.description: Relabeling rules to apply on log entries.

arguments.name: address
arguments.description: The <host:port> address to listen to for syslog messages.

arguments.name: idle_timeout
arguments.description: The idle timeout for TCP connections.

arguments.name: label_structured_data
arguments.description: Whether to translate syslog structured data to Loki labels.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.description: The labels to associate with each received syslog record.

arguments.name: max_message_length
arguments.description: The maximum limit to the length of syslog messages.

arguments.name: protocol
arguments.description: The protocol to listen to for syslog messages. Must be either tcp or udp.

arguments.name: rfc3164_default_to_current_year
arguments.description: Whether to default the incoming timestamp of an rfc3164 message to the current year.

arguments.name: syslog_format
arguments.description: The format for incoming messages. Must be either rfc5424 or rfc3164.

arguments.name: use_incoming_timestamp
arguments.description: Whether to set the timestamp to the incoming syslog record timestamp.

arguments.name: use_rfc5424_message
arguments.description: Whether to forward the full RFC5424-formatted syslog message.
